title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Payment Application, Nonpayment Suspension and Reinstatement
content:
# Payment Application, Nonpayment Suspension and Reinstatement

Billing Operations rule for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Payments, including partner utility remittances, are applied oldest unpaid charge first. Coverage is suspended only when a premium remains unpaid more than the plan's payment grace period in calendar days after the premium's due date; the count starts the day after the due date. No service request is accepted on a suspended plan. A suspended plan is reinstated only when the premium balance is zero or less and the payment posts no later than the plan's suspension cure period in calendar days after the plan was suspended; the count starts the day after the suspension date and the boundary day itself qualifies. A suspended plan not cured within that window is cancelled for nonpayment with no refund.

## Suspension for nonpayment

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the premium's due date (the first day of its billing period) |
| Counting | calendar days, starting the day after the due date |
| Condition | the premium remains unpaid more than the grace period |
| The last day of the grace period | does not satisfy the condition; suspension requires more than the grace period |
| Authority | Bridgewell's billing record of the period's due date |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 30-day grace period assumed):* a premium due on 1 May is counted from 2 May, which is day 1; 31 May is day 30. A premium still unpaid on 31 May has not remained unpaid more than 30 days, so coverage is not suspended on that day. On 1 June, day 31, it has.

## Reinstatement

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Event the clock starts from | the plan was suspended (the suspension date on the plan record) |
| Counting | calendar days, starting the day after the suspension date |
| Conditions | the premium balance is zero or less, and the payment posts no later than the last day of the cure period |
| The last day of the cure period | qualifies |
| Authority | Bridgewell's records of the suspension date, the premium balance and the posting date |

*Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, a 30-day cure period assumed):* a plan suspended on 5 June is counted from 6 June, day 1; 5 July is day 30. A payment that brings the balance to zero or less and posts on 5 July allows reinstatement. A payment posting on 6 July is outside the window.

| Balance after payment | Payment posted within the cure window | Reinstated |
|---|---|---|
| zero or less | yes | yes |
| above zero | yes | no |
| zero or less | no | no |
| above zero | no | no |

## Consequences

- No service request is accepted while the plan is suspended.
- A suspended plan not cured within the window is cancelled for nonpayment, and no refund is made.
- Every payment, a partner utility remittance included, settles the oldest unpaid charge first.
